name: buridan-toc-scrollspy-repro
description: jsdom + react-router-dom harness that reproduces the production-rendered TOC link hrefs so the scrollspy setActive logic in app/templates/toc.py can be exercised against the real router shape. react and react-dom are pinned to the same versions shipped by the Reflex web app (see reflex.lock/package.json); react-router-dom is deliberately pinned to the latest 7.x release, ahead of reflex.lock, to clear the advisories tracked in #146; jsdom is pinned independently to the version below.
